name: Status & models endpoints
description: GET /health and GET /v1/status: provider/model, OmniRoute reachability, dynamic model probe results, readiness reasons, and the web chat mode/tools flags (web_agent_mode, web_chat_path, tools_exposed_to_model, tools_note); GET /v1/models: the curated OmniRoute catalog — 'auto' plus dynamically discovered free models, with headless/CI bridge routes excluded.
